To rotate without downtime, create a second service account, move the integration over to it, and revoke the first one once the switch is confirmed.
Revoke deletes the service account and invalidates its outstanding access tokens right away.
If you still authenticate with an API key, migrate to a service account: the credentials are scoped per integration, the tokens are short-lived, and revocation takes effect immediately.
